item.title: The targeted poaching of lions has potential to become an existential threat for the species in Africa • Wildlife Conservation Network
item.description: Africa’s lions are facing a complex and evolving set of challenges. Over the past 25 years, the continent’s lion population has declined by roughly half, leaving a maximum of 25,000 individuals remaining today, occupying just 6% of their historic range. Habitat loss, declining prey, and direct conflict with people have long shaped the conservation landscape for lions. item.title: Floating Otters, Real Impact: How LEGO Fans Can Help Sea Otters Return Home • Wildlife Conservation Network
item.description: Here at the Sea Otter Fund, we’re otterly excited about LEGO’s new Floating Otter set (21366), released on March 1 -- it's fun to build, adorable to display and true to nature! We’ve teamed up with the Fan Designer, Maximilian Lambrecht, the creative mind behind the design, and are thrilled to announce the Sea Otter Naming Contest. Let’s turn your passion for LEGO into a lifeline for real sea otters along the California coast!
